title: Indore's Lalbagh Palace Yields Mysterious Old Safe During Road Construction, Archaeology Officials To Investigate
description: An old safe was discovered during road construction near the Rose Garden at Indore's historic Lalbagh Palace on Tuesday. Palace staff moved it inside for safekeeping. A woman claimed the locker was her ancestral property. State Archaeology Department officials are expected to inspect the discovery on Wednesday, clarifying its background.
